text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
No one can catch Kitasan Black!
She's
made up for last year's defeat, and
today is
a celebration of her talent!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Wow, what an imposing performance!
Kitasan
Black's on a different level than
before!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
The skills of last year's Star Umamusume
haven't
diminished in the slightest!

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond's still got room to grow
too. I doubt she'll take this loss lying
down. These two
rivals are going to be
must-watch entertainment!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Both Kita and Dia are getting so much
better!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
In which way do you mean exactly?
...Not that I
don't agree.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Watching them race kinda reminds me of
our own
duel.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: You mean at the spring Tenno Sho?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps that will be their next race as
well.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Maybe! By the way...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I reeeaaally feel like running right now!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oh? What a coincidence. So do I.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Let's race back to the station on our way
home!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes. I'd like that.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
All riiiiight! The Osaka Hai is miiine!
One
down!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ngh!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(She's on a completely different level
than she
was at the Arima Kinen!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (I thought I had caught up to her...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (But she's improved so much!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...Just as I thought I'd caught up, you
left me in
the dust again.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Well, I did work super hard to beat you!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I knew I had to, after seeing how strong
you were
at the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I really gave it everything I had, but it
still wasn't
close to enough...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
But that just means I have to try even
harder! I
definitely won't lose next time!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, let's race again! I wanna run with
you as
much as possible!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
After all, my desire to beat you helps
drive me to
become even faster!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Next up is the spring Tenno Sho! I want
you to
enter too!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The spring Tenno Sho... So you're aiming
for a
consecutive win?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yep! At 3,200 meters, it's the longest
G1 race. I
wanna run it with you.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Talk to your Trainer and give it some
thought.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I'll be waiting for you in Kyoto!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: So, Trainer... About my next race...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes! ...But how did you know?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond said she wanted to
pursue
Kitasan Black while thinking
about what it means
to be illustrious.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If Kitasan Black is her goal, it stands to
reason
that she'd want to enter the same
races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And knowing Satono Diamond, she'd
have extra motivation for the spring
Tenno Sho, a race where Kitasan Black
excels and is aiming for consecutive 
victories.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
You see right through me. Hm... If that's
the case,
it shouldn't be a problem if I
decide things on the
spot next time.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I'm just kidding. ♪
choice_data_list: No, at least consult me first?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Today's defeat made me realize that I'm
not yet
strong enough to become an
illustrious runner.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I have to beat Kita at the spring Tenno
Sho!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'd also like to bring the honor that goes
with it to
the Satono family.
